description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class FeaturesNotModifiableException used in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically in the context of handling errors related to attempting to modify features of a Thing component when insufficient permissions exist. It provides various constructors, builder patterns, and JSON parsing capabilities for this exception.

classes.name: FeaturesNotModifiableException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating that features of a Thing cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions.
